t: The Luceco FType flat bezel in polished chrome offers a sleek and unobtrusive finish for lighting installations. This lighting accessory is particularly suitable for projects involving decorating and painting ceilings, ensuring a clean aesthetic. Its slim design integrates seamlessly, while the robust polycarbonate construction provides durability. A convenient twist-lock feature simplifies installation and maintenance, making it compatible with flat versions of Luceco FType Essence, FType Mk2, and FType Ultra models.
b: Twist-Lock Feature For Quick & Secure Installation
Slim Design Ensures an Unobtrusive Ceiling Finish
Ideal For Decorating & Painting Ceiling Projects
